title: 2 Secrets Hidden Inside the Ford Mustang GTD
description:
The Ford Mustang GTD has no useful trunk. The space where your luggage would go is taken up by a cooler for the gearbox. And its rear wing can flatten itself out like a drag-racing flap, while two flaps under the nose open to keep the car balanced. These are two secrets hidden inside the Ford Mustang GTD, a Mustang that costs more than three hundred thousand dollars. One: the layout, with a gearbox at the back, a carbon-fibre driveshaft and a cooler where the cargo space should be. Two: the aerodynamics and ride height, which change shape when the car goes onto a track. Along the way we will look at the lap time, the price, and the racing car it came from. Every fact comes from a published source, listed in the description.

Every figure in this video comes from a published source, listed below.
